<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is lack of live repair progress visibility and automatic notifications for garages/policyholders. The most similar item, 'Policyholder milestone notifications' (Notion), covers automatic notifications at key milestones, but its status is truncated and it addresses policyholder notifications only, not live repair progress from garages. The completed story 4129 (supplier contact details) solves a different problem, and the other items (Claims timeline, Task list improvements, Task overview) address general progress tracking, not live repair status or garage notifications. No shipped story or roadmap item clearly covers the same core problem of live repair progress and automated notifications to reduce manual calls.", "verdict": "pass"}
